start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: The final piece slides into place. A profound silence hangs over the stone table, broken only by the distant desert wind.

AWD2.speaker: Anubis
AWD2.text: The scales have tipped... in your favor, mortal. A victory, earned and absolute. I am a god of my word.

AWD3.speaker: Player
AWD3.text: Yes! So, about that pin... and my yarn ball?

AWD4.speaker: Kronos
AWD4.text: Hah! Did you see that, Anubis? The student becomes the master! I taught them everything they know, of course. A natural, wouldn't you agree?

AWD5.speaker: Anubis
AWD5.text: Your boasting is as tiresome as your gambling habits, Kronos. The mortal won through their own merit, not your... 'tutelage'.

AWD6.speaker: Narrator
AWD6.text: Anubis raises a hand, and the 'Pin with the Logo' materializes from the shadows, hovering above the table before gently floating towards you.

AWD7.speaker: Anubis
AWD7.text: A deal is a deal. The trinket is yours. Use its power more wisely than its previous owner.

AWD8.speaker: Kronos
AWD8.text: Splendid! We'll take that! One down, a few more to go. No time to waste, my friend, the cosmos awaits!

AWD9.speaker: Player
AWD9.text: Wait, what power? What does this pin even do?

AWD10.speaker: Anubis
AWD10.text: Be wary, little one. The path you walk with him is fraught with peril. Not all debts can be settled with a game.

AWD11.speaker: Kronos
AWD11.text: Oh, don't be such a downer, Anubis! We're on a grand adventure! Come on, into the box, let's not keep destiny waiting!

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: Before you can ask more questions, Kronos hastily shoves you towards the strange, pulsating box. The last thing you see is Anubis's stoic, jackal-headed form, a silent statue against the Egyptian sun.
